basic_info.description: Experience Edwardian Charm with Modern Upgrades in Bernal Heights. Discover the perfect blend of historic charm and modern luxury in this beautifully remodeled 2-bed, 2-bath condominium. Set on a quiet street in the heart of Bernal Heights, this home offers a small-town feel with urban convenience. Restored hardwood floors and high cove ceilings highlight the home's Edwardian heritage, and owned solar offsets the unit's PG&E. The flexible floor plan includes a large en-suite bedroom with contemporary finishes, and versatile front and rear rooms that can serve as living room, bedroom, den, or dining area. The modern kitchen features sleek countertops, a versatile island, and stainless steel appliances - perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Outside, enjoy a shared backyard with vibrant bougainvillea, a Meyer lemon tree, and a custom patio with fire pit. Just a 10-minute walk to Cortland Avenue's shops and restaurants, two minutes to Holly Park, and close to Muni, Silicon Valley shuttles, and downtown. This thoughtfully updated home seamlessly combines period details with contemporary comfort, offering a stylish urban retreat for families, couples or individuals in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, this condo is more than a home, it's a lifestyle - Welcome Home!
